description.en: Thin wrapper around CMND_RESERVE_EVENT (with the fixed "STD" category) — reserves a story/quest event to run once the current one finishes.
Numeric ID of the event to reserve.
Optional; whether to overwrite any already-reserved event (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Reserve the next event to run once this one finishes
ReserveEvent(42081400, true);
